sections.label: ESTABLISH
sections.html: When declaring a Ballistics Action against a creature in line of sight, you may spend one additional die without rolling it to establish your Lock on that creature before resolving the Action.

sections.label: LIMIT
sections.html: You may normally maintain one Lock. Establishing a new Lock ends your previous Lock. Different Ballistics users may each Lock the same creature independently.

sections.label: LOSS
sections.html: Lose your Lock if the target remains completely outside your line of sight through the end of your turn.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
